decisions.claim: B has been running around in front of the TV
decisions.reason: Imperative 'Stop running around' solidly presupposes B is currently performing that action.

decisions.claim: A tells B to sit and watch the TV
decisions.reason: Explicit suggestion/proposal by A directed at B ('Why don't you just sit and watch?').

decisions.claim: A tells B to stay away from something
decisions.reason: Explicit imperative from A ('Then stay away') with clear speech act.

decisions.claim: A intends to explain something to B later
decisions.reason: Explicit statement of A's future intention ('I will explain it to you later on').
Explicit imperative command ('Now scram') directed at B.

decisions.claim: B did or offered something that is exactly what A wanted
decisions.reason: 'That's exactly what I want' presupposes B did/offered something; the referent 'that' points to B's action.

decisions.claim: B is running around in front of the TV
decisions.reason: c7 restates the same presupposition as c1 (B running around in front of TV). c1 is the more complete formulation with mechanism noted.

decisions.claim: B has asked or demanded that A explain something
decisions.reason: 'I will explain it to you later' presupposes B has asked/demanded an explanation; reasonable inference from the conversational context of A responding to a request.
decisions.counterexample: B might not have asked; A could be volunteering an explanation unprompted.

decisions.claim: B has complained about or implied being prevented from doing something
decisions.reason: 'Nobody's keeping you from doing that' presupposes B has complained about or implied being prevented; solid conversational inference from the defensive phrasing.
decisions.counterexample: A might be preemptively stating this without B having complained.

decisions.claim: B has done or said something that is exactly what A wanted
decisions.reason: c10 is equivalent to c6: both assert B did/said something that is exactly what A wanted. c6 is the more direct formulation.
